thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we're planning to start the default-model unpin deprecation next quarter. Wanted to call out the migration checklist and get quick review :eyes:
Aj Patel: Thanks. Do we have a canonical timeline? end-of-quarter or phased?
Maria Chen: Phase 1: announce + warnings for 4 weeks. Phase 2: strict 30-day deprecation window. Phase 3: automatic fallback to pinned variant. Total ~10 weeks.
Kyle Rogers: Where does the Accept-Version header fit here vs client pin param? Some SDKs only set model param.
Maria Chen: Good question. We will support both. Priority is header negotiation for service-to-service, query param for SDKs. Fallthrough order: explicit pin -> Accept-Version header -> default.
Aj Patel: Any compatibility checks for response shape changes? We should avoid breaking consumers that rely on optional fields.
Maria Chen: Yes — contract rule: any removal of top-level fields must be behind a versioned opt-in. Adding fields ok. We also plan to run schema diffs on 10 high-traffic routes before roll.
Ivy (Product): Can we publish a migration FAQ? People will ask about latency/cost differences across pinned models.
Maria Chen: Yep. I'll draft a FAQ and a short migration playbook. Will include recommended pins per tier.
Kyle Rogers: For the canary, suggest 1% traffic for 48h, then 5% for 24h, then 25% for 24h. If errors or QoR regressions >1% we roll back.
Aj Patel: How do we detect QoR regressions? Is there an automated eval hook?
Maria Chen: We'll run our eval harness on the canary set with the baseline prompt suite. If delta in BLEU/ROUGE/LLR metrics exceeds thresholds we block rollout. Also manual spot-checks from ML team.
SRE Bot: deploy-notice: canary deploy scheduled 2026-05-03T10:00Z for service inference-api-v2.
Maria Chen: For client-facing SDKs: we'll add a warning log when default is unpinned: "Deprecated default model selection will change in 30 days". We won't change the server behavior until the window closes.
Kyle Rogers: Need a short code snippet for SDK teams to opt-in. Something like:
```js
// force pin to legacy model until migration complete
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-legacy-v1', prompt: '...' })
```
Aj Patel: Also add migration flag in server config to force old behavior per-customer (enterprise).
Maria Chen: Agreed — per-customer override via config and audit log.
Ivy (Product): Can marketing help craft the deprecation email? We'll need precise dates and rollback instructions.
Maria Chen: I'll share the timeline doc and the migration checklist in this thread. Please leave comments.
Kyle Rogers: I'll review the checklist tonight and ping for CR.
Aj Patel: I'll add the schema-diff CI job to eng-releases and link the dashboard.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. If no objections I'll post the public announcement Monday and start the 4-week warning cadence.
Kyle Rogers: :thumbsup:
Aj Patel: :+1:
Ivy (Product): :raised_hands:
Maria Chen: tagging follow-ups: @Aj Patel (schema diffs), @Kyle Rogers (canary runbook), @Ivy (customer comms).
